title: Health & alerts
subtitle: Endpoint checks, process alert rules, and recent events
loading: Loading health checks and alert rules…
loadFailed: Monitoring could not be loaded. Select Refresh to try again.
refreshFailed: Live updates are unavailable. These are the last received readings; select Refresh to retry.
saveFailed: Changes could not be saved. Your draft is still here; try again.
conflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Cancel and reopen the editor to review the latest configuration before saving.
draftOutdated: Configuration changed while you were editing. Your draft is preserved. Cancel and reopen to review the latest settings.
pausedUntil: Paused until {{time}}. Checks and alert evaluation continue.
maintenanceHint: Pause outgoing notifications during maintenance. Checks and alert evaluation keep running.
probeLocation: Checks run from the EZPM2GUI server, even for applications on remote servers. Use an address reachable from this server; localhost refers to this server, not an SSH target.
noChecks: Add an HTTP or TCP check to detect an unreachable application even when PM2 reports it as online.
disabledCheckHint: A disabled check does not collect results. Alert rules that use it show Unknown until the check is enabled and has a result.
timeoutError: The timeout must be shorter than the check interval.
rulesHint: Require a condition to persist before firing. A cooldown limits repeat webhook notifications; recovery events are recorded too.
targetsFailed: Process targets could not be refreshed. Select Refresh to retry; existing rules continue running.
noRules: Add a rule for a health check, CPU, memory, restarts, or an offline process. Events appear below when a rule fires or recovers.
processGroupHint: All PM2 instances with this process name are monitored together on the selected server.
webhookHint: Optional HTTP(S) endpoint for JSON notifications. Leave blank to record events only. Use a trusted endpoint.
deleteLinkedRules: This also deletes {{count}} linked alert rules. Existing events remain in the history.
eventsHint: Firing and recovery events with their webhook delivery status. This list refreshes every 5 seconds while the page is open; monitoring continues on the server when you leave.
noEvents: No alert events yet. Events will appear when an enabled rule fires or recovers.
